title: Continuity equation on metric spaces via measure-valued derivations and BV-Wasserstein curves
summary: We introduce a notion of continuity equation on metric spaces that is capable of describing curves of probability measures which are absolutely continuous, and more generally of bounded variation (BV), with respect to the 1-Wasserstein distance. This continuity equation is based on a notion of measure-valued derivations, whose basic theory is also developed in this paper. On $\mathbb{R}^n$, our formulation is consistent with the continuity equation with singular flux introduced by Almi--Rossi--Savaré (arXiv:2506.15333), including the corresponding notion of minimal solutions.
